decisions.reason: As a close extension of the core physical-music offer in a growing market, this schlager CD is easy to justify and likely to be retained despite limited evidence because the firm has already publicly launched it and can attribute any weak early response to ramp-up time.

This illustrated release series represents a more visible and resource-intensive line with several models that fits the firm's stated broadening strategy, so escalation of commitment makes management especially likely to continue it rather than withdraw it quickly.
